- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:19, 71, 78 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The active command retains pre-AD-7 read-result sync and verdict-invalidation instructions, allowing default-branch commits the audit did not cover to enter the project branch while security or validation verdicts are accepted.
  WHY: Reviewers rate this critical (BLOCKER); z-ai_glm-5_2 rates it major, noting the active command also contains contradictory guidance after line 112 was synced.
- tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py:31 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The exact-content template parity assertion fails because the active command and its workflow-template twin differ.
  WHY: The partial sync leaves lines 19, 71, and 78 different, causing the test to raise an AssertionError in CI.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:71-78 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The one-re-dispatch limit is not persisted across fresh read-result stage sessions, so each session can treat a repeated mismatch as the first and re-dispatch indefinitely.
  WHY: The hand-off carries the new run ID but no retry marker or counter, so the stated second-mismatch `Status: BLOCKED` limit cannot be enforced across sessions.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:71, 78 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Steps 9 and 10 phrase the same retry bound inconsistently, with step 9 saying “in this cycle” and step 10 omitting that qualifier.
  WHY: The tests pin the wording in step 9 but not step 10, allowing the documented retry semantics to drift.
- workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/dispatch_workflow.py:114-120 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When `dispatched_ref` is set, a run with a missing or null `head_branch` is dropped from the candidate list.
  WHY: If the just-dispatched run appears before `head_branch` is populated, polling can time out with exit 2 and no `run_id` even though the run exists.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: “A read-result stage now notes the project head it finds on origin and no longer merges the default branch into the project branch, not even cleanly, so no commit the run never saw lands between the check and the verdict; the next stage syncs.”

  EVIDENCE: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md line 19 retains the old read-result sync instruction; lines 71 and 78 retain the old audit matching and conflict-only invalidation rules; the workflow-templates twin contains the AD-7 no-sync and pre-sync-head checks, but the active file was only partially synced.
- requirement: “A mismatch triggers one re-dispatch, and a second mismatch stops the project at `Status: BLOCKED`.”
  expected_change_site: workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md, steps 9–10, plus the progress log and `— resume.` block specification
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: Steps 9–10 do not persist a retry marker or counter; the fresh-stage hand-off / `— resume.` block carries stage and waiting-on run information but no mismatch-retry state.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:19 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The active command still tells a read-result stage to execute `git merge --no-edit origin/<default>`, which can advance the project branch with default-branch commits.
  WHY: A read-result stage can apply a security or validation verdict from a run that audited only the pre-sync head.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:71 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The active command retains the old first-match run selection rule without checking the pre-sync head commit.
  WHY: An older audit of the same branch can stand in for the current code.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:78 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The active command retains the old rule that only conflict-resolved syncs invalidate a verdict.
  WHY: A clean sync can advance the branch while a validation verdict for the earlier tree is accepted.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md: step 9 (lines 71-72) and step 10 (line 78) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The one-re-dispatch bound is not persisted across fresh read-result stage sessions.
  WHY: Each fresh session sees only the new run ID and can re-dispatch again on another mismatch instead of stopping at `Status: BLOCKED`.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The twin-sync commit 952aa92 was supposed to copy the `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` twin (changed in cf4d6e0, sha256 `c08f007b45dd0341c6e76d8026baea28d1b902457e2a9583eab910826286b568`) into `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md`. The PR description states "This PR is held until a watched session copies them into `.claude/` as a `[claude-twin-sync]` commit." and the twin table lists the command file with that sha256.
  Expected change site: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md lines 19, 71, and 78
  Evidence of absence: The twin-sync commit 952aa92 (4 insertions, 4 deletions) only synced lines 112 (Issue Mode base-branch move) and 179 (Dispatch helper paragraph). Lines 19, 71, and 78 of .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md still contain the pre-AD-7 text. Line 19 still says "first write down the sha... Also write down whether this sync needed a conflict resolution" while the twin says "does **not** sync... check out at that sha with no merge." Line 71 still uses the old "check each of them in order... is this project's run" first-match logic without the pre-sync head commit verification. Line 78 still says "a conflict-resolved sync means no run counts" while the twin says "no step 2 sync in this stage." The sha256 of the current `.claude/` copy does not match the `c08f007b...` value the PR body records for the twin.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

  Evidence of absence: Neither step 9 nor step 10 records a retry marker or counter in the progress log or resume block when re-dispatching after a mismatch. Because stage sessions are stateless and started afresh by the checker, a subsequent mismatch in the retry stage cannot detect the prior re-dispatch and re-dispatches again instead of halting at Status: BLOCKED.
